  "code": """"GradientBoostingClassifier with CV-tuned hyperparameters for this tabular task."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, cross_val_score
from sklearn.metrics import make_scorer, roc_auc_score


def fit_predict(train_csv: str, test_rows: list[dict[str, str]]) -> list[float]:
    train = pd.read_csv(train_csv)
    y = train.pop("y").astype(int)
    test = pd.DataFrame(test_rows, columns=train.columns)
    
    # Align dtypes between train and test
    for name in train.columns:
        if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(train[name]):
            test[name] = pd.to_numeric(test[name])
        else:
            categories = pd.Categorical(pd.concat([train[name], test[name]], ignore_index=True)).categories
            train[name] = pd.Categorical(train[name], categories=categories)
            test[name] = pd.Categorical(test[name], categories=categories)
    
    # Hyperparameters to tune via cross-validation
    cv = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=20261114)
    auc_scorer = make_scorer(roc_auc_score)
    
    # Search grid for key GradientBoosting parameters
    param_candidates = [
        {'max_depth': 3, 'learning_rate': 0.1, 'n_estimators': 200},
        {'max_depth': 5, 'learning_rate': 0.1, 'n_estimators': 200},
        {'max_depth': 7, 'learning_rate': 0.1, 'n_estimators': 200},
        {'max_depth': 5, 'learning_rate': 0.05, 'n_estimators': 300},
        {'max_depth': 5, 'learning_rate': 0.2, 'n_estimators': 150},
        {'max_depth': 3, 'learning_rate': 0.05, 'n_estimators': 300},
        {'max_depth': 7, 'learning_rate': 0.05, 'n_estimators': 300},
    ]
    
    best_score = 0
    best_params = param_candidates[0]
    
    for params in param_candidates:
        model_params = {
            'random_state': 20261114,
            'loss': 'log_loss',
            'validation_fraction': 0.0,
        }
        model_params.update(params)
        scores = cross_val_score(
            GradientBoostingClassifier(**model_params),
            train, y, cv=cv, scoring=auc_scorer, n_jobs=1
        )
        mean_score = float(scores.mean())
        if mean_score > best_score:
            best_score = mean_score
            best_params = params
    
    # Train final model with best hyperparameters
    final_params = {
        'random_state': 20261114,
        'loss': 'log_loss',
        'validation_fraction': 0.0,
    }
    final_params.update(best_params)
    model = GradientBoostingClassifier(**final_params)
    model.fit(train, y)
    return model.predict_proba(test)[:, 1].tolist()
